title: Minor boys also not safe: Karnataka HC says it will scrap Vachanananda Swamiji's anticipatory bail in POCSO case
description: The Karnataka High Court on Tuesday strongly criticised Vachanananda Swamiji, Jagadguru of the Veerashaiva Lingayatha Panchamasali Peetha, while indicating that it would cancel the anticipatory bail granted to him in a case involving allegations under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. Justice M Nagaprasanna orally observed,"You have not left the boys! The minor girls are not safer, minor boys also not safer."The Court said that it would set aside the anticipatory bail
